title: Smoked Anticuchos
description: A Peruvian-style grilled beef heart skewer dish, typically served as an appetizer or snack.

ingredients.name: limeno
ingredients.notes: such as aji amarillo pepper paste

instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef heart, hot pepper, garlic, limeno, soy sauce, black pepper, and smoked paprika. Mix well to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef heart pieces onto bamboo skewers.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the anticuchos hot, garnished with additional hot pepper slices if desired.
